description: This file contains utility functions for formatting serialized bitstream data into a human-readable textual representation within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: BitStreamFormatter
classes.description: Static utility class providing methods to format and display serialized bitstream data as text.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the provided reader into a string representation of the serialized data.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a buffer slice with session into a string representation.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a byte array with session into a string representation.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a ReadOnlySpan<byte> with session into a string representation.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a ReadOnlyMemory<byte> with session into a string representation.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a ReadOnlySequence<byte> with session into a string representation.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a Stream with session into a string representation.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Lower-level method that formats the reader object into a StringBuilder result, analyzing the current field.

methods.name: FormatField
methods.description: Formats a specific field within the reader, possibly recursively, depending on wire type.

methods.name: FormatByteArray
methods.description: Converts a byte array into ASCII or hex string based on content analysis.

methods.name: FormatFieldHeader
methods.description: Appends the field header information to the StringBuilder for debugging.

methods.name: FormatTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Reads and formats a tag-delimited field, recursively processing nested data.

methods.name: AppendAddress
methods.description: Appends the current position as hex address into the StringBuilder.
